description: Does another process see a table that a level created while that level is open, after it rolls back, and after a second created table commits? Both processes open the main file shared read/write in Workspaces(0). a: BeginTrans; CREATE TABLE X (ID LONG primary key); INSERT INTO X (ID) VALUES (1) (dbFailOnError). b: TableDefs refreshed and its names read; SELECT ID FROM X read through a new snapshot; DBEngine.Idle(dbRefreshCache); the same two reads again. a: Rollback; DBEngine.Errors. b: the same reads on X. a: BeginTrans; CREATE TABLE Y (ID LONG primary key); INSERT INTO Y (ID) VALUES (1); CommitTrans; DBEngine.Errors. b: the same reads on Y, again after a 7 s pause.
retentionNote: Designed r-txn-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
